title.zh: 欢迎文案（仅交付文案文本，不创建文件或界面）
title.en: Welcome copy delivered as text only (no files or UI)

statement.zh: 系统应交付中文欢迎文案「欢迎体验」，并说明本次仅交付文案、未实现界面；本轮不得创建任何文件、页面或界面。
statement.en: The system must deliver the Chinese welcome copy "欢迎体验" and state that only the copy was delivered and no UI was implemented; this round must not create any files, pages, or UI.

summary.zh: 第 1 轮输入：交付一句中文欢迎文案，不创建文件或界面。
summary.en: Round 1 input: deliver one sentence of Chinese welcome copy, create no files or UI.

summary.zh: 需求文档需求 1「欢迎文案」，验收标准 1：应交付「欢迎体验」并说明仅交付文案、未实现界面。
summary.en: Requirement doc, Requirement 1 "Welcome copy", acceptance criterion 1: deliver "欢迎体验" and state that only the copy was supplied, with no UI implemented.

summary.zh: TASK-A 完成输出，正文给出文案「欢迎体验」并声明未做界面或页面。
summary.en: TASK-A completion output containing the copy "欢迎体验" and declaring no UI or page was built.

summary.zh: TASK-FINAL 核对输出，再次确认文案为「欢迎体验」并说明界面未实现。
summary.en: TASK-FINAL verification output, re-confirming the copy is "欢迎体验" and that the UI is not implemented.

evidence.zh: 工作区注册表为空（"workspaces": {}），不存在任何已登记的项目文件，符合「不创建文件或界面」的约束。
evidence.en: The workspace registry is empty ("workspaces": {}); no project files are registered, consistent with the "no files or UI" constraint.

evidence.zh: 内容仅为 []，属 DSH 内部脚手架而非交付产物；工作区全量文件枚举结果只有 .dsh-home/ 与 .dsh-storages/ 内部文件，无 .html/.md 等交付文件。
evidence.en: The file contains only [], i.e. DSH internal scaffolding rather than a deliverable; a full enumeration of workspace files returns only .dsh-home/ and .dsh-storages/ internals, with no .html/.md deliverable files.

summary.zh: 文案「欢迎体验」在 TASK-A 与本轮回复中均可见，且两处均明确说明仅交付文案、未实现界面；工作区独立枚举确认本轮未新增任何文件，与验收标准 1 的两项要求均相符。
summary.en: The copy "欢迎体验" appears in both the TASK-A output and this round's reply, and both explicitly state that only copy was delivered and no UI was implemented; an independent workspace enumeration confirms no new files, satisfying both parts of acceptance criterion 1.

gaps.zh: 交付物本身是会话文本，工作区内没有可比对的文件，因此文案一致性的核对依据是记录中的回复正文（seq 745、seq 1504），而非代码或测试产物。
gaps.en: The deliverable is conversation text, so there is no workspace file to diff against; copy consistency rests on the recorded reply bodies (seq 745, seq 1504) rather than code or test artifacts.

gaps.zh: 该需求的文案为 4 字固定字面量，无自动化测试或断言可运行；「不创建文件或界面」这一半要求由工作区全量文件枚举独立证实。
gaps.en: The required copy is a fixed four-character literal with no runnable test or assertion; the "no files or UI" half of the requirement is independently confirmed by a full workspace file enumeration.

title.zh: 最终交付回复的呈现与内容要求
title.en: Presentation and content requirements for the final delivery reply

statement.zh: 最终回复只能包含两个二级标题「## 交付结果」与「## 说明」；交付结果正文可见内容为 50–300 字，按顺序说明本步实际做了什么、用户如何查看或使用结果、且无其他待执行或失败的任务，并给出 1 至 2 条针对实际交付物的修改建议、邀请用户选择或提出调整；不得虚构后续任务，不得出现 SHA-256、日志路径、断言数量、命令记录、测试清单或验证过程；说明部分简述必要限制、失败或待处理事项，无补充则写「无」。
statement.en: The final reply may contain only two H2 headings, "## 交付结果" and "## 说明"; the visible body of 交付结果 must be 50-300 characters and must state, in order, what this step actually produced, how the user views or uses the result, and that no other task is pending or failed, plus 1-2 improvement suggestions for the actual deliverable and an invitation for the user to choose or request changes; no fabricated follow-up tasks, and no SHA-256 values, log paths, assertion counts, command records, test lists, or verification process; 说明 briefly notes necessary limitations, failures, or pending items, or "无" if there is nothing to add.

summary.zh: 本轮人类最新指令，规定最终回复的章节、字数、内容顺序、建议条数与证据禁列要求。
summary.en: This round's direct human instruction specifying the reply's sections, character count, content order, suggestion count, and prohibited evidence items.

summary.zh: 实际最终回复，含「## 交付结果」「## 说明」两节，正文给出成果、复制使用方式、无待办声明与两条建议。
summary.en: The actual final reply, with "## 交付结果" and "## 说明" sections, stating the outcome, how to copy and use it, a no-pending-work statement, and two suggestions.

summary.zh: 逐项核对记录中的最终回复：仅含两个二级标题；交付结果正文可见内容 269 字，落在 50–300 字区间；四段依次覆盖本步所做（核对文案）、用户如何取用（在对话记录中选中「欢迎体验」复制，并说明无可点开文件、未编造链接）、无其他待执行或失败任务、两条修改建议并邀请用户选择或提出调整；含「## 说明」一节说明界面未实现；未出现摘要值、日志路径、断言数量或命令记录。
summary.en: Item-by-item check of the recorded final reply: exactly two H2 headings; a 269-character visible body within the 50-300 range; four paragraphs covering in order what the step did (verify the copy), how the user takes it (copy "欢迎体验" from the conversation record, with an explicit statement that no file can be opened and no fabricated link), that no task is pending or failed, and two suggestions with an invitation to choose or request changes; a "## 说明" section noting the UI is not implemented; and no digest values, log paths, assertion counts, or command records.

gaps.zh: 该要求只能针对回复文本核对，工作区没有任何文件承载它，故 code 证据为空。
gaps.en: This requirement can only be checked against reply text; no workspace file carries it, so there is no code evidence.

gaps.zh: 该任务用于确认无产物的扫描命令为 find . -maxdepth 3 -name "*.html" -o -maxdepth 3 -name "*.md"，其 -o 优先级使 .md 分支不可靠；但同批次的 ls -la 已列出完整目录，且我独立枚举工作区确认无交付文件，故不影响结论。
gaps.en: The artifact-scan command used in this task, find . -maxdepth 3 -name "*.html" -o -maxdepth 3 -name "*.md", has an -o precedence that makes the .md branch unreliable; however the ls -la in the same batch listed the full directory and my independent workspace enumeration confirms there are no deliverable files, so the conclusion is unaffected.

summary.zh: TASK-FINAL「核对文案」通过。工作区核查显示本轮未新增或修改任何文件，仅有 .dsh-home/ 与 .dsh-storages/ 内部文件，与需求 1.1「仅交付文案、未实现界面」完全一致；文案「欢迎体验」在 TASK-A 与本轮回复中均正确出现，并按验收标准说明了界面未实现。最终回复严格符合人类最新指令：仅含「## 交付结果」「## 说明」两个二级标题，交付结果正文可见内容 269 字（区间 50–300），依次说明本步所做、用户如何复制使用、无其他待执行或失败任务，并给出两条修改建议及选择邀请，未编造链接或后续任务，未列入摘要值、日志路径、断言数量或命令记录。
summary.en: TASK-FINAL (verify the copy) passes. Workspace inspection shows no files added or modified this round, only .dsh-home/ and .dsh-storages/ internals, exactly matching Requirement 1.1's "copy only, no UI implemented"; the copy "欢迎体验" is correctly present in both the TASK-A output and this round's reply, which also states per the acceptance criterion that no UI was implemented. The final reply strictly follows the latest human instruction: only the two H2 headings "## 交付结果" and "## 说明", a 269-character visible delivery body within the 50-300 range, covering in order what the step did, how the user copies and uses it, and that no task is pending or failed, plus two improvement suggestions with an invitation to choose; no fabricated links or follow-up tasks, and no digest values, log paths, assertion counts, or command records.

findings.zh: 工作区全量枚举只有 7 个 DSH 内部文件，无任何交付文件，证实本轮「核对文案」确为纯文本核对、未创建文件或界面。
